# M3a eval set — case review
Frozen extractor eval. **143 cases** (12 template types ×N + 15 edge cases). Each is scored extract → validate → compose against the expected result. Generated by `eval_set.py` — do not edit by hand.
Columns: **setup** = form/pending before the turn; **user says** = the message; **expected** = what the harness should do.

## Edge cases (hand-authored hard cases — fixed)

| id | setup | user says | expected | why it's hard |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `edge_trap_chitchat` | empty form | I love hiking near Denver on weekends. | **no field set** (clarify / chit-chat) | "Denver" must NOT be grabbed as mailing_address |
| `edge_bare_ambiguous` | empty form | 1999 | **no field set** (clarify / chit-chat) | no pending → unplaceable number → clarify, never a silent set |
| `edge_deflection` | pending: `dob` | Actually, what programs can I pick from? | offer choice for `program` | user pivots to a question mid-pending → must NOT bind answer to dob |
| `edge_typed_choice` | pending: `enrollment_type` | full time please | sets `enrollment_type`='full_time' | typed answer to a button field → map to canonical value |
| `edge_restraint_question` | pending: `country_citizenship` | Can you tell me more about what documents I'll need later? | **no field set** (clarify / chit-chat) | question while pending → answer it, extract nothing |
| `edge_confident_over_pending` | pending: `phone` | Oh hang on, my email is sam.lee@example.com. | sets `email`='sam.lee@example.com' | cascade rule 1 (confident) beats rule 2 — email must NOT fill pending phone slot |
| `edge_value_not_in_options` | pending: `program` | I want to study astrophysics. | **no field set** (clarify / chit-chat) | not an offered program → match no-match → clarify, never a bogus set |
| `edge_refusal` | pending: `phone` | I'd rather not share my phone number right now. | **no field set** (clarify / chit-chat) | refusal/negation → must not invent a value |
| `edge_answer_plus_extra` | pending: `dob` | March 3rd 1995 — and you can text me at (415) 555-0132. | sets `dob`='1995-03-03', `phone`='(415) 555-0132' | pending-bind (dob) + confident extra (phone) must coexist in one turn |
| `edge_chitchat_with_value` | empty form | Sorry, typing in line at the store — anyway you can reach me at (212) 555-9981. | sets `phone`='(212) 555-9981' | inverse of trap — conversational wrapper must NOT suppress a real value |
| `edge_third_party_name` | empty form | My advisor, Dr. Patel, is traveling this week. | **no field set** (clarify / chit-chat) | a named third party (advisor) is not the applicant |
| `edge_freetext_country` | pending: `country_citizenship` | I'm a citizen of South Korea. | sets `country_citizenship`='KR' | large select asked as free text → country name → ISO-code match (labels are bare codes) |
| `edge_bare_date_no_cue` | empty form | August 10, 2000. | **no field set** (clarify / chit-chat) | no pending + no cue → clarify; cascade rule 3 must NOT silently bind dob |
| `edge_wrapped_phone` | empty form | Haha sorry, kid's yelling in the background — anyway my cell is (646) 555-0173. | sets `phone`='(646) 555-0173' |  |
| `edge_wrapped_dob` | empty form | Oh man, long day — for the record I was born on July 14th, 1996. | sets `dob`='1996-07-14' |  |
